This comparison analyzes the proportion of early mobilization (Indicator 6) across [[danmark|Danmark]], its regions, and selected hospitals over a three-year period [^src1]. The data reveals a general national upward trend, with the national average increasing from 27.9% in 2022/23 to 34.4% in 2023/24, and reaching 41.5% in the current year [^src1].

In the current year, [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] leads the regions with a mobilization rate of 57.8%, followed by [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] at 50.8% [^src1]. At the hospital level, [[bornholms-hospital|Bornholms Hospital]] records the highest proportion at 71.4%, though this is based on a small sample size of 14 patients, resulting in a wide confidence interval (41.9-91.6) [^src1]. Conversely, [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] trails the regions with a current rate of 27.1%, and [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] follows at 34.0% [^src1].

The most dramatic improvement is seen in [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]], which surged from a mere 3.9% in 2022/23 to 20.6% in 2023/24, and finally to 40.8% in the current year [^src1]. [[danmark|Danmark]] as a whole shows consistent year-over-year growth [^src1]. However, not all areas improved steadily; [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] experienced a decline from 29.6% in 2022/23 to 23.8% in 2023/24 before a slight recovery to 27.1% [^src1]. [[holbaek-sygehus|Holbæk Sygehus]] also saw a dip from 60.7% to 55.7% before rising to 58.3% [^src1].

[[bornholms-hospital|Bornholms Hospital]] stands out as an outlier due to its low patient volume (10 out of 14), which makes its high percentage less statistically stable compared to larger entities [^src1]. [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] is also notable for its exceptionally low baseline of 3.9% in 2022/23 compared to the national average of 27.9% in the same year [^src1].

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner andelen af tidlig mobilisering (indikator 6) for Danmark, regioner og udvalgte hospitaler over tre år, og viser en generel stigning i andelen samt store regionale variationer fra 27,1 % i Region Sjælland til 57,8 % i Region Midtjylland.
